pattern: ^\[Win32App DO\] DO downloading is not finished within timeout, jobId = [^,]{0,64}, fileId =.*?intunewin-bin_{GUID}
description: Detects when a Delivery Optimization download times out for a specific app (identified by GUID in the DO fileId). Source literal (ContentDownloaderDeliveryOptimization, identical IME 1.97-1.105): "[Win32App DO] DO downloading is not finished within timeout, jobId = {0}, fileId = {1}".
